limitations: Monochrome unhinted outlines only. Color tables are presence metadata, not glyph color availability or paint support. A monochrome path must not silently replace a color glyph.

HarfBuzz float callbacks quantize to signed design64 integers, nearest ties away. This is not an exact rational outline representation. No curve extrema, ink bounds, rasterization or page composition yet.

path:null means outline unavailable or failed without a precise interpreter diagnostic; path:[] is a valid empty outline. A successful batch status does not imply every glyph has a drawable representation.

Output callbacks and HB weighted outline interpretation have separate limits. Font construction/table sanitization are not all charged to the caller work counter. Synchronous component calls still require host timeout/worker termination.

300 injected allocation positions on one owned variable/composite input are bounded failure evidence, not exhaustive fuzzing or an adversarial font sanitizer proof. Rust/JS allocator failures remain host failure boundaries.

Independent FontTools comparison covers owned glyf/gvar/CFF fixtures, not arbitrary CFF2/VARC/color fonts. Its composite offset normalization is derived solely from its own font instance, not from measured output.

The same-algorithm upstream reference verifies adapter/instance consistency, not independent HarfBuzz correctness. Disabling float contraction plus this corpus is not universal platform determinism proof.
No persistent font cache or per-frame glyph deduplication yet. Glyphs batch per font instance; performance acceptance and production cancellation/hosting remain incomplete.
Editable advanced objects, full render/playback, Office/WPS acceptance, Agent product interfaces and Musterwork E0-E3 replacement gates remain incomplete.
